tip.1: 1. Put chips on the table: arrows and {x}, or the mouse.

nowebgl.title: YOUR GPU FOLDED
nowebgl.body: This window needs WebGL2 to draw the wheel. Try a recent Chrome, Firefox or Safari, or enable hardware acceleration.
gpu.title: YOUR BROWSER IS DRAWING BY HAND
gpu.body: Hardware acceleration seems to be off: your processor is painting the wheel frame by frame, so it will stutter. You can still play, but it runs much smoother on the graphics card.
gpu.chrome: Chrome, Edge or Brave: Settings → System → “Use graphics acceleration when available”, then restart the browser.
gpu.firefox: Firefox: Settings → General → Performance → untick “Use recommended performance settings” and tick “Use hardware acceleration when available”, then restart the browser.
gpu.safari: Safari: it is usually always on. If it is still slow, try another browser.

howto.claude.title: SPIN WITH CLAUDE
